entries.description: Three-storey fictional apartment building in the Garden modern look: ivory plaster with warm brick accents, charcoal railings, timber entry and balconies around a leafy central courtyard. Holds at least four private apartments plus the shared common room; every new world starts here.
entries.name: Apartment building

entries.description: Ground-floor private apartment facing the courtyard, with bed, kitchen counter and stove, table with chairs, and bathroom fixtures. Warm ivory walls, pale timber floor, teal textile accents.
entries.name: Apartment 1

entries.description: Upper-floor private apartment with a railed balcony over the courtyard, with bed, kitchen counter and stove, table with chairs, and bathroom fixtures. Same Garden modern palette of ivory, timber and teal.
entries.name: Apartment 2

entries.description: Corner private apartment with windows on two sides, with bed, kitchen counter and stove, table with chairs, and bathroom fixtures. Bright daylight interior in ivory and pale timber.
entries.name: Apartment 3

entries.description: Top-floor private apartment under the eaves, the quietest unit, with bed, kitchen counter and stove, table with chairs, and bathroom fixtures. Cozy Garden modern finish throughout.
entries.name: Apartment 4

entries.description: Shared common room off the courtyard with pale timber, teal woven seating and warm ivory walls. Hosts BookClub meetings, gatherings and everyday social life for all building residents.
entries.name: Common room

entries.description: Central leafy courtyard with timber benches, raised planters, the minigolf course and the garden beds. Plausible pedestrian routes join the building entry, the houses and the block destinations.
entries.name: Courtyard

entries.description: Outdoor 3-hole courtyard minigolf course, par 3 per hole, for matches of one to four players with no entry fee. The selected minigame; timber-edged greens set among the courtyard planting.
entries.name: Minigolf course

entries.description: Raised courtyard garden beds with timber edging, tended by GardenClub. Herbs, flowers and greenery in brick planters matching the Garden modern courtyard.
entries.name: Garden beds

entries.description: Corner grocery store with a serving counter where residents buy GroceryUnits and household supplies. Modest shopfront with awning on the block sidewalk.
entries.name: Grocery store

entries.description: Compact recreation building with exercise equipment and a classroom wing. Hosts courses, club life and indoor sport for the whole block.
entries.name: Recreation center

entries.description: Classroom inside the recreation center with desks and computers. Hosts CulinaryCertificate and ComputerSkills course sessions.
entries.name: Classroom

entries.description: Green park area with trees, lawn, benches and paths. A leisure and exercise destination shared by the whole block.
entries.name: Park

entries.description: Oak House, a single-storey purchasable cottage with a timber porch, pitched roof and a mature oak in the front garden. Distinct from Willow House in size, roofline and planting.
entries.name: Oak House

entries.description: Willow House, a two-storey purchasable house with a balcony, a garden wall and a willow tree shading the side yard. Distinct from Oak House in height, entry and garden character.
entries.name: Willow House
